label: BREX system
definition: A phage defense system in which an organism possesses a bacteriophage exclusion locus that uses host DNA methylation to discriminate self from non-self and inhibit phage DNA replication.
observations: Methylation-based bacteriophage-exclusion branch under phage defense system; distinct from the pglX, pglZ, and brx gene products, generic Pgl growth-limitation labels, individual source rows naming one BREX locus, and other antiphage systems such as DISARM, CBASS, abortive infection, and phosphorothioate defense.
